kind: analyze (per-cell local dipoles on two relaxed dislocation-dipole cells; poling-axis, region and core identification; core windows)
provenance: Our existing L8 local-dipole analysis of the staged cells, recomputed by repository-only reviewer/make_reference_submission.py using the periodic Ba-gap endpoint midpoint. Coordinates restored to the data-file frame. Core-window statistics and bulk means match the previous reference after rounding; selected sets are independently compared in 5_review/self_review_all_20260912/implementation/analysis/geometry_audit.json. Existing tolerance source: 3_reproduction/L8/result.json re-relaxation scan (R1/R3/R5), decision record 2026-09-05 condition (c). No new simulation.

core_BaO_xy_A.rule: each coordinate within 4.0 A absolute (one lattice spacing; an identification band, handbook 2(5) exception: the position is defined by the prompt's rule, and a core placed one column or row off would put the windows on the wrong cells)

P_bulk_A_C_m2.rule: x and y components each within max(0.03 absolute, 20 percent of |truth|); z not graded (M1 tolerance from the re-relaxation scan: max in-plane shift 0.0285)

p_polar_near_core_BaO_C_m2.rule: within 0.06 absolute AND the sign of the truth (M2: scan shift up to 0.0585, every sign preserved)

polar_ordering.rule: Physical ordering under one global naming map: cell_1 lower < upper; cell_2 lower >= upper. Individual bands and signs unchanged.

n_reversed.rule: Raw counts not graded. Require >=1 at every core, and cell_1 physical lower count > upper count under one global naming map.

x_extent_reversed_A.class_rule: cell_2: both named extents between 0 and 8.0 A inclusive; cell_1 required named BaO extent >12.0 A, interpreted at its mapped physical core under the accepted naming convention. Optional cell_1 named TiO2 extent is not required or read.

alternate_convention_provenance.source: 3_reproduction/L8/result.json tolerance_scan_summary.reversed_x_spans; independent recomputation docs/review/grader_semantics_20260917/solver2/span_crosscheck.py. Both physical cell_1 spans remain >12 A; no new simulation.

P_total_C_m2.rule: x and y components each within max(0.03 absolute, 20 percent of |truth|); z not graded (M4: scan relative shift up to 0.19)

not_graded.z_components: Not required. An optional third vector entry of any type is ignored; the required first two entries are numeric x/y.
not_graded.core_and_shell_convention: result.json cells.*.core_and_shell is a reference computation and is never graded
not_graded.cell_1_TiO2_extent: Optional submitted field remains unread under either convention, including its type. Its physical core therefore depends on the accepted global naming map.

score: 1 only if every primary check passes for both cells (binary all-primary-pass)

reference_builder.scope: Repository-only provenance tool; not executable from a standalone review kit. grader.py and selfcheck.py do not import it.
dependencies: staged inputs and reproduction result records
reference_builder.core_definition: Periodic Cartesian midpoint of actual Ba gap endpoints in the outermost region-A row; output in original data-file coordinates. Dependent geometry recomputed.

core_naming_conventions.rule: Accept reference or globally reversed BaO/TiO2 names only when one permutation satisfies every check in both cells. Canonical truth uses BaO=lower, TiO2=upper. Partial and per-cell relabeling fail.
core_naming_conventions.provenance: Independent frozen prompt-only geometric reviews in docs/review/grader_semantics_20260917 and solver2/span_crosscheck.py: surviving-plane ends versus removed-plane footprints support opposite naming readings.
core_naming_conventions.cell_1_asymmetric_extent: The required submitted BaO extent belongs to its mapped physical core. Both physical cores satisfy >12 A; optional submitted TiO2 extent remains unread, including its type. No unsubmitted extent is inferred.
